name: Her Pen
source:
Constance, a young writer, is plagued by her uninteresting and bad life at home, but finds that one night she's visited by a stranger. He introduces himself, and she realizes that he is one of the characters in one of her stories! This game follows their quest to rid his world of the monsters that have taken control of his small town.

[From [url=http://mikomikisomi.itch.io/her-pen]itch.io[/url]]

Created for [url=http://ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-32/?action=preview]Ludum Dare 32[/url] (Theme: An Unconventional Weapon).
translation:
康斯坦斯是一位年轻的作家，她因家里的无趣和糟糕的生活而苦恼，却发现有一天晚上她被一个陌生人拜访了。他自我介绍，她意识到他是她故事中的人物之一！在这款游戏中，他们追寻着摆脱控制小镇的怪物的世界。

[来自[url=http://mikomikisomi.itch.io/her-pen]itch.io[/url]]

为 [url=http://ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-32/?action=preview]Ludum Dare 32[/url] 创建（主题：非常规武器）。
